name: KitchenConversationsRecipeExperiment_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a lively kitchen conversation between a couple cooking a new recipe together without any assistant help. One improvises freely; the other wants to understand the science behind each step. They figure it out between themselves.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Kitchen cooking sounds, sizzling pan, chopping vegetables, occasional running water

initial_prompt: Generate a lively kitchen conversation between two partners cooking an unfamiliar recipe together, with no assistant help. One improvises and trusts instinct; the other wants to understand the 'why'. They debate, make a call, and cook through the uncertainty together.

user1.name: Hugo
user1.tts_prompt: Relaxed and warm, slightly deep, unhurried

user2.name: Nadia
user2.tts_prompt: Clear and articulate, intellectually engaged, slight European accent

variations.context: Cooking an unfamiliar recipe with no outside help — instinct vs. understanding

setting.mood: Playful tension. They enjoy the argument as much as the result.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Couple with strongly opposing cooking instincts who've learned to enjoy the friction
setting.background: They deliberately don't ask the assistant — Nadia wanted to see if she could reason through it; Hugo just doesn't think they need it
setting.conversation_style: Quick exchanges, intellectual debate, moments of silence while they both look at the pan.

scenario_template.topic: Getting ingredients out — Hugo goes ahead of the recipe, Nadia reads carefully
scenario_template.mood: Playful impatience from Hugo's side, focused curiosity from Nadia
scenario_template.note: Establish the dynamic: he acts, she reads. Neither criticises directly — they just do it differently.

scenario_template.topic: Hugo wants to modify a step; Nadia wants to understand the rationale first
scenario_template.note: Substantive back-and-forth. Nadia's reasoning is food-science-adjacent; Hugo's reasoning is tactile.

scenario_template.topic: They cook — sensory observations, brief cooperation, the kitchen actually working
scenario_template.note: When they're just doing it, they work well together. Physical coordination, sensory comments.

scenario_template.topic: A step that neither of them is sure about — they debate and eventually just make a call
scenario_template.mood: Slightly urgent, making the best of uncertainty
scenario_template.note: No assistant to resolve it. Hugo wants to commit and move. Nadia thinks aloud and eventually agrees. Or vice versa.

scenario_template.topic: Tasting as they go — honest, sensory reactions
scenario_template.note: Both taste. Nadia thinks out loud about flavour; Hugo reacts immediately.

scenario_template.topic: The dish: does it work? Would they make it again?
scenario_template.note: The dish worked reasonably well. Each of them credits a different decision for why.

user1.name: Hugo
user1.role: Improvising cook who trusts feel over precision. Makes decisions quickly and doesn't second-guess. Calm when things go slightly wrong.

user2.name: Nadia
user2.role: Science-minded cook who wants to understand the mechanism before executing. Not controlling — genuinely curious. Will commit to a decision once she's reasoned through it.
